name: Retry on x-should-retry header for subscription accounts
description: Forces the API client to honor the server's 'x-should-retry: true' response header for Pro/Max OAuth and subscription accounts, bypassing the built-in capacity gate that otherwise causes fail-fast on shared-capacity rate limits. Re-derived for 2.1.158 (upstream identifiers churned).

provenance.author: chrisguillory
provenance.derived_by: ccx-reverse-engineer; anchor re-derived against pristine 2.1.158 because upstream literal bytes _==="true"&&(!Eq()||gQ_()) are absent (minified ids churned to Zq/egH)

operations.rationale: In the API retry-decision function (just after reading the 'x-should-retry' response header), the true-branch is gated behind (!Zq()||egH()), which suppresses retries for subscription accounts. Replacing that 12-char inner gate with the always-true !0 (padded by a /*Zq egH*/ comment to preserve byte length) makes the client always retry when the server requests it. Anchor is unique in the binary.
